page_title: BHA 2-1 FUL | Brighton v Fulham 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+8' 2 - 1 Goal! Bernd Leno gets a hand on the penalty from Joao Pedro (Brighton), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
90+7' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+7' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is yellow-carded.
90+6' Harrison Reed (Fulham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Brighton!
90+3' Simon Adingra (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Diego Gomez (Brighton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Iwobi leaves the pitch and Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) comes on.
88' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Simon Adingra (Brighton) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
86' Here is a change. Carlos Baleba is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Mats Wieffer (Brighton).
86' Kaoru Mitoma will be replaced by Simon Adingra (Brighton).
84' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header!
83' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Brighton for a penalty. Play continues.
82' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Harrison Reed (Fulham) replaces Andreas Pereira.
82' Emile Smith Rowe goes off the pitch and Willian (Fulham) comes on.
80' Flag up against Solly March (Brighton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

79' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
77' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danny Welbeck (Brighton) replacing Georginio Rutter.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yankuba Minteh departs the field of play to be replaced by Solly March (Brighton).
74' 3:6 – the corner kicks stats.
69' We are about to witness a subsitution. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) for Raul Jimenez.
69' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Yasin Ayari is replaced by Diego Gomez (Brighton).
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonee Robinson (Fulham) was quite harsh and Samuel Barrott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
63' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) commits a rough foul. Samuel Barrott stops the game and makes a call.
61' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
61' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Iwobi (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
56' The Brighton players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Samuel Barrott signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
55' The Brighton players joy may have been justified, because referee Samuel Barrott is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
55' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) has a goal ruled out for offside!
54' Sander Berge (Fulham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Samuel Barrott saw the whole situation.
53' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) blazes well wide of the right post.
52' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
50' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
47' A cross into the box from Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is cleared.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
44' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

41' 1 - 1 Perfectly executed free kick. Yasin Ayari floats the ball in and Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) leaps high to connect with it near the penalty spot. His bullet header flicks off the post into the left side of the goal. The score is now 1:1.
41' It looks like Andreas Pereira (Fulham) saw red with that tackle. Samuel Barrott won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! Alex Iwobi puts a cross into the box and finds Raul Jimenez (Fulham), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 0:1.
34' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle.
29' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
28' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Bernd Leno stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
25' Now Fulham have a corner.
24' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
23' A corner kick by Fulham is thwarted by the well prepared Bart Verbruggen (Brighton).
22' Adam Webster (Brighton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
19' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
15' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.
13' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
13' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
12' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
11' The linesman points to the corner flag, Fulham are going to take it.
10' Fulham fail to score from a corner as Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) leaps to collect the ball.
8' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Andreas Pereira (Fulham), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
3' A pass from Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is intercepted by Bernd Leno and the move breaks down.
3' Bart Verbruggen is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Joachim Andersen (Fulham). Easy save!
1' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) and Yankuba Minteh attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Brighton will kick-off.
Samuel Barrott is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
